title: Maria N Possible NDE 3655
content: I was suffering from bronchitis and I went to hospital to have some x-rays done. Before going into the x-ray room, I felt short of air. I couldn't breathe. I felt as if I was dying, I felt death very close, I knew I was going to die. I told the nurse who was helping me that I was dying. I wanted to see my daughter, who had gone out, so she could know that I was dying. All of a sudden, I felt something coming out of my body, something from myself was coming off me. I didn't want this to carry on before I could see my daughter. Something was pushing me to leave the chair where I was sitting. My mind was telling me that I didn't want to go before I could see my daughter and tell her about the beautiful experience I was going through. I closed my eyes and saw a virgin; something wanted to take me but when I insisted on wanting to see my daughter, it left me alone and I felt my body back on the chair again. I think that if I hadn't refused, I would have died, I don't know, but when I refused, the force that I was feeling left me alone. In spite of everything, I didn't feel frightened at all, but a pleasant sensation; it was something nice of which I wasn't afraid. It was like saying: You stay on earth or you leave. Something like that.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt 'something coming out of my body' and 'something was pushing me to leave the chair where I was sitting.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: The 'force' stopped when she refused to go; she 'felt my body back on the chair again.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Bronchitis with acute shortness of breath while awaiting X-rays.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Perceived a choice: 'You stay on earth or you leave.' Also reported seeing 'a virgin.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Breathing crisis and sense of dying, followed by partial separation sensation while seated; vision of a virgin; refusal/choice led to return sensation in body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The experiencer reports being seated in a hospital chair during X-ray prep, feeling a force pushing her to leave the chair/body, and stopping it by insisting on seeing her daughter first; describes it as a choice ('You stay on earth or you leave').
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “All of a sudden, I felt something coming out of my body, something from myself was coming off me.” / “I closed my eyes and saw a virgin; something wanted to take me but when I insisted on wanting to see my daughter, it left me alone and I felt my body back on the chair again.” / “It was like saying: You stay on earth or you leave.”
